result.title: CADET: Construction of PCB Routing Instances with Executable Demonstrations
result.comment: 28 pages, 10 figures, 15 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/LGAI-Research/CADET
result.summary: Printed circuit board (PCB) routing is the stage of physical layout that finds paths connecting the placed pads of each net. Public datasets in this domain are few, and most contain only the final states of routed boards, not demonstrations of the electronic design automation (EDA) engine actions that produce them. To close this gap, we propose CADET (Constructing executAble Demonstrations for Engine-grounded Training), which jointly generates synthetic boards and demonstrations built from EDA engine actions. The resulting RouteDemos provides 100,000 synthetic boards routed with zero design rule violations (DRVs), together with their demonstrations. Their distributions over 17 statistics resemble those of 142 real reference boards. CADET trains a routing policy on these demonstrations with behavior cloning and fine-tunes it with reinforcement learning (RL). On real test boards, the policy raised the rate of complete DRV-free routing from 38.0% to 67.2% over an RL-only baseline. This rate was comparable to that of the open-source autorouter FreeRouting and exceeded those of the other baselines, including GPT-6 Astra. We release the dataset and its generation code as open source at https://github.com/LGAI-Research/CADET.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CADET，用 EDA 引擎动作联合生成合成 PCB 板及其可执行演示，构成十万块零 DRC 违规板的 RouteDemos 数据集，并据此以行为克隆加 RL 微调布线策略。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「由权威引擎动作构造可执行演示轨迹」的监督与分配思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理轨迹的构建、过程监督与贡献分配提供参照，但布线任务本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理，可迁移性需核查。
